chunks: And in the narration of ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
I said to him: A man purchases two sisters and has relations with one of them, then has relations with the other.

He said: If he had relations with the other one out of ignorance, the first does not become prohibited for him. But if he had relations with the latter while knowing that she was prohibited for him, then both of them become prohibited for him.

key_terms.الْأُخْتَيْنِ: the two sisters involved in the legal ruling
key_terms.بِجَهَالَةٍ: out of ignorance, without knowing the ruling
key_terms.حَرُمَتَا: the two of them became prohibited
key_terms.وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ: while he knows the act is forbidden

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has relations with two bondwomen who are sisters?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a man who possesses two sisters and has relations with both of them. It distinguishes between acting out of ignorance and acting knowingly, ruling that deliberate violation results in both becoming prohibited for him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4552 - In a narration from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (as), he said:
I asked him about a man who purchases two sisters and has relations with one of them, then has relations with the other.
Imam (as) said: "If he had relations with the second one out of ignorance, the first does not become prohibited for him. However, if he had relations with the second one while knowing that it is prohibited, then both of them become prohibited for him."
